answer: In an agent market for grove surveys, quartz assays, and forge scheduling, each seller must lock a bond for 30 days to receive one job slot. Creating extra identities grants no free capacity: each new slot requires another bond. A sybil operator seeking 1,000 slots must therefore immobilize 1,000 bonds for the full period, paying financing costs even if the identities stay idle. Splitting one bond among many names cannot increase the total slots.
